t: The Essentials 2-gang dry lining box is designed for secure and efficient electrical installations in cavity walls. This box provides ample space for wiring single sockets and switches and delivers a clean, flush finish when installed. Constructed from durable polypropylene, it features adjustable lugs for a precise fit and multiple knockouts at the top, bottom, and rear for flexible cable entry. A built-in earth terminal ensures safety and compliance for all electrical work.
